$schema: Machine-readable feature state tracker. Source of truth for status; per-feature MD docs are source of truth for design/runtime.

policy.definition_of_done: implementation complete + verify-done passed + feature MD updated + brain coherent

features.name: Feature Verification
features.description: feature-verifier sub-agent drives the live app via the Playwright CLI (throwaway headless script), screenshots the golden + one error path, and writes a per-feature verdict doc. Replaces per-feature e2e specs; thin CI smoke specs remain the regression net.
features.evidence: shipped 2026-07-13; self-verified: .brain/features/authentication/verifications/2026-07-13.md (PASS); harness-check 11/11; hardened clean-browser launch after dry-run extension artifact; agent .claude/agents/feature-verifier.md

features.name: OpenTelemetry Span Tracing
features.description: Effect span tracing across tRPC procedures, repositories, and services. Custom Effect Tracer exports OTLP JSON via fetch to an env-configured endpoint (OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT + OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS + OTEL_SERVICE_NAME); complete no-op when endpoint unset. Logger auto-annotates every log with traceId/spanId from the current span so logs and traces correlate. Includes a span-instrumenter sub-agent + rules/recipe updates so every new endpoint/repo method gets instrumented, and docs for MCP-based trace debugging by local agents.
features.evidence: verify-done full pass: typecheck PASS, 301/301 unit tests, e2e smoke 2/2 (isolated port — stray unrelated dev server on 5173), production build PASS, non-negotiables sweep clean, effect-ts-enforcer 0 findings, harness-check 10/10. Live verification: real OTLP trace captured from dev server (root trpc.admin.getUsers server span + 2 db.query user client child spans, one POST on runtime.dispose) — .brain/features/otel-tracing/verifications/2026-07-29.md

features.name: Sample SaaS Landing (Loadline)

What it produced and what survives: ui-builder, design-critic, scripts/design-audit.ts, recipes/add-premium-surface.md, the scoped-design-systems convention, and runs/2026-07-30-design-slop-postmortem.md.
